svg.title: Mount of Olives — original unified engraving V3
svg.desc: Two anatomically connected old olive trees framing the speaker folios and one uninterrupted landscape view down cultivated terraces to Jerusalem; narrow etched olive leaves grow from physically connected boughs. One copperplate, not a V11/V12 collage or stamped leaf wallpaper.
svg.metadata: Original artwork by Westside Watch (2026-11-06). Visual research basis: public-domain William Miller Olea europaea Botanical Cabinet plate 456 and John Douglas Woodward / Charles Cousen Jerusalem from Mount of Olives (1881-84). All V3 strokes newly authored; no reused rejected V11 or V12 paths. Original V1 and V2 remain archived for honest A/B comparison.
